steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in service mode
steps.body: Service mode entered. Use Light key (SW2) to navigate to the step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use SW2 to advance steps; SW5 toggles loads.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 11
steps.body: Use Light key (SW2) to advance until Freezer TEMP LEDs show step 11 (Damper heater). Wait at least 1 second between key presses.

steps.title: Damper heater energizes
steps.body: At step 11, damper heater turns on. Can you verify heat at damper housing?
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 11, damper heater turns on. Can you verify heat at damper housing?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No heat — check P11-3 ↔ P11-4 (12 VDC) or damper heater element.

steps.title: Replace damper heater
steps.oemOutcome: Replace damper heater or damper assembly.

steps.title: Damper heater verified
steps.oemOutcome: Damper heater operates in service step 11.
